blocking_issues.object: S1 / EM450 waterbar operation and maintenance
blocking_issues.fact: V5 confirms the same placement, countertop contact, outer envelope, and 94mm static gap as V4. S1 refill, cup placement, drip-tray cleaning, tank removal, EM450 operation/steam-wand clearance, heat dissipation, and simultaneous-use space remain unverified. S1 remains 14mm from the cabinet north edge; EM450 rear model margin remains about 7.5mm.
blocking_issues.required_change: 按最终SKU说明书或实机补做操作、补水、清洁、拆卸、散热和维护包络验证。

blocking_issues.fact: V5 does not move the cabinet, S1, EM450, or wall-control band. Accessible grounded outlets, circuit capacity, simultaneous load, protection, and wall-control reachability remain unresolved.
blocking_issues.required_change: 按实际面板、柜体剖面、设备铭牌和回路资料验证墙控与供电。

blocking_issues.fact: V5 only changes S1. The RO internal cabinet cavity, partitions, trap, feed/drain, power, faucet, and filter/device extraction path remain unverified.
blocking_issues.required_change: 按最终RO SKU和水槽柜实测内腔建立维护剖面并确认全部接口。

non_blocking_notes: V5 runtime确认ready=true、configErrorBanner为空，S1 AABB为0.106×0.280×0.312m，底面仍与0.85m台面接触，EM450静态间距仍为0.094m。
水位标识local z范围[-0.006,-0.004]m，水箱壳体范围[-0.053,-0.006]m；指标贴在壳体东/前表面并向局部+z凸出2mm。局部+z映射世界东侧，所以没有发现它位于西侧或新增遮挡。
V5没有新增静态AABB碰撞；水箱壳体、盖板、水位标识和东侧出水结构仍是程序化外观代理，不能证明真实流路、容量、排水或维修路径。
V5 runtime、close/overview snapshots、截图哈希和sourceDigest已登记到review-manifest；被墙体完全遮挡的west-camera试拍单独标为invalid，不作为当前模型证据。
V5 test-server结果含既有worktree失败，没有报告S1几何本身失败；verify:all最新结果16/17，唯一失败是另一份电气决策文档的重复DEC编号。
requested_changes: 继续核验S1/EM450现场操作、维护、清洁、散热、供电和墙控。
继续核验RO柜内有效空间、给排水、电源、独立龙头和滤芯维护路径。

新增水箱壳体、顶盖、出水仓和接水盘仍是程序化外观代理。
RO contained结果不代表柜内安装通过。
